notes: The lexical shortlist was badly off for this task - almost none of the top-ranked shown candidates involve ELF or binary-format parsing, and the strongest matches (task_000148_13b866f9, task_000005_ceefb305, task_000101_5b83d1ba, tw_101812, tw_18948, tw_381835, tw_12138, tw_48562, rts_task_e1f7416ab6e845547bffe641, rts_task_27d9611d05b6a0d7288b1436) all came from my own regex searches for ELF/readelf/little-endian/magic-number/virtual-address. TMax and TerminalWorld are both strong here; RTS has a large family of readelf/objdump metadata chores that are real but shallow. SWE-Smith has no ELF work at all, so I picked its byte-level codecs (pyasn1 BER/DER, pdfminer xref-stream and stream decoders) where the offset-table and octet-decoding skill genuinely transfers. SWE-Rebench is the weakest pool: only pfp (a binary-template interpreter) and memray are really on-topic.
